hints.title: Left Right Root Order
hints.text: Process descendants in both left and right branches completely before recording the current node value.

hints.title: Reverse Preorder Mirroring
hints.text: Modifying preorder to visit root then right then left produces the exact reverse of the postorder traversal sequence.

hints.title: Iterative Postorder via Reverse Output
hints.text: Push root onto stack. Pop node, append value to output, push left child then right child. After completing traversal, reverse output list to obtain true left-right-root postorder.

complexity.notes: Optimal linear traversal with stack size bounded by height.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking visited child pointers iteratively without reversing requires extra state maps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Root-right-left stack traversal followed by output reversal avoids visited node tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Explain both two-stack / reversed preorder and one-stack with last-visited pointer.
